Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Kyle Mayers and Brandon King will open the batting for West Indies. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will begin with the new ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

West Indies will be a tad disappointed. They started off well but leaked over 75 runs in the last six overs and let India get away with it. Other than, Roston Chase no other bowler found their mojo in the middle. West Indies need 187 runs and they have enough firepower in their batting to chase this down. Also, with the dew coming in, Indian bowlers could be in trouble. Will West Indies come out on top and level the series? Or will India seal the series? We will find out!

Virat Kohli is down for a quick chat. He says that it was a different situation and he just tried to be positive about it. Tells that he is happy to go with clear intent and is happy it came off nicely. Adds, there is a responsibility and he just needs to back himself and play with intent. Tells the crowd creates good energy and he just needed to create a good environment. Informs it is a good total and the bowlers just need to be smart enough. Mentions Pant and Iyer, on the way they finished the innings.

India would be mighty pleased after being asked to bat first they have done an exceptional job to post a target of 187. After the openers fell cheaply it was Virat Kohli who came in and displayed his aggression straightaway but he perished soon after an exquisite half-century. He needed some runs and stood up on the right occasion. But it was the partnership of Pant and Venkatesh Iyer who put together 76 runs and guided India to a healthy total. The batters have done well and now it's up to the Indian bowlers to defend this and seal the series.

An outstanding display of batting by the hosts! They did lose wickets, but the runs always kept coming in for them! West Indies would be disappointed a bit, they leaked many runs at the backend, and the partnership between Rishabh Pant and Venkatesh Iyer was the one that hurt the visitors the most. They face a tough challenge ahead, but the Men in Maroon have a brutal batting line-up who could chase this down.
A good final over from Romario Shepherd! A full toss, outside off. Pant only manages an inside edge towards fine leg for a single. India end at 186/5
Fifty for Rishabh Pant! What a knock this is! Giving India much needed finish! A length ball, way outside off. Pant tries to chase it and chops it to long off for a couple of runs.
Just a single! Another yorker, on middle, Patel works it to mid-wicket.
Harshal Patel walks out to bat now.

OUT! TIMBER! Venkatesh Iyer's cameo comes to an end. A super yorker from Shepherd, around off. Iyer fails to dig it out and the ball sneaks through to hit the stumps. Turning out to be a good final over so far. Can Romario Shepherd finish it well?
Wide! Full ball again, way outside off. Left alone.
Full and way outside off. Pant chases and hits it to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and on off, driven to long off for a run.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.

Wide! Too many extras from the Windies! Full ball, again down the leg side. Iyer misses his flick. Pant wants a quick bye but is sent back from halfway mark. Pooran throws to the bowler but the ball hits Pant in its way and the run out chance goes away. Pant didn't change his line though.
Bye! A full ball, way down the leg side. Pant attempts the reverse hit but misses. Iyer calls for a quick bye and they make it with ease. Pooran misses his shy at his end.
FOUR! Good shot! A full ball, drifting on the pads. Pant gets low and sweeps it, did not middle but just helped it wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
Full ball, on off. Iyer works it to long on for a single.
A yorker, on middle. Pant squeezes it out, it rolls on the deck but both run across to take a quick single.
SIX! What a start to the over! A full toss, on off. Pant whacks it, more of the helicopter shot, over cow corner for a biggie. His one hand came off but that is the power of Pant.
Length and on off. Venkatesh Iyer miscues his shot back to Shepherd. 12 coming off the over.
FOUR! In the gap! This partnership continues to hurt West Indies! Full ball way outside off. Iyer skips down and slashes it to covers for a boundary.
Very full and on off, Pant knocks it to covers for a single.
WIDE! Full ball but way outside off. Wided.
Length and on middle. Pant flicks it to deep square leg where the fielder runs to his right and saves a couple of runs.
A length ball, on off. Iyer shuffles and smashes it straight down the ground. Pollard at long off comes across and flicks it just wide of the adjacent fielder. Three runs taken easily.
On middle, this is hit to long on for one run.
Full and on off, punched to long off for a single.
Romario Shepherd comes back to bowl. He went for 15 runs in his first over!
TWO WIDES! Full and straying down the leg side. Good stop from the keeper as he dives way to his right. Quick single taken.
SIX! Powered! A short ball, on middle. Iyer stands tall and pulls it off the middle and over square leg for a biggie.
Low full toss, on  the pads. Pant hits it to deep square leg for a single.
Leg bye! Length ball, angling on the pads. Iyer misses his heave and gets hit on the pads. It lobs to the left of pitch and a leg bye is taken.
A yorker, on off. Iyer digs it out back to Holder. Good delivery.
A fuller ball, on middle. Iyer flicks it wide of long on and takes a couple of runs.
FOUR! Top shot! This is angling on the pads. Pant whips it off his pads and to the square leg fence. 15 coming off it.
Length and on middle, whacked to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Valiant effort! That is the only thing, Venkatesh Iyer knows, to go big! A slower short ball, on middle. Iyer pulls it towards deep square leg where Brandon King runs to his left, dives but to no avail.
FOUR! Freebie! A full ball, down the leg side. Iyer whacks it to fine leg for a boundary.
A length ball, angling on off. Pant pushes it to mid on for a single.
On the pads, this is flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Slower, fuller, and wide of off. Rishabh Pant looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge past point for another boundary. 14 runs off Kieron Pollard's first over! Big one for India!
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Outside off, on a length. Rishabh Pant smashes this wide of long off for a boundary.
Pollard doing Pollard things. Just at the time of releasing the ball, he stops and has a view at the batter.
A length ball, down the leg side. Rishabh Pant offers no shot on that, but the ball brushes off his pads and goes towards the boundary. Dot ball there, since there was no shot offered on that!
Slower ball, on length, around off. Venkatesh Iyer works it away towards wide of long on for a single.
Another shorter ball, around middle. Rishabh Pant pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Shot! A shorter ball, around middle. Rishabh Pant pulls it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Change. Kieron Pollard to bowl now.
Shorter ball, on the stumps. Venkatesh Iyer blocks it out. End of a fine spell by Roston Chase
FOUR! EDGY! A fuller ball, outside off. Venkatesh Iyer looks to drive but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a boundary.
Venkatesh Iyer makes his way out.

OUT! CLELAND HIM UP! What a spell this is turning out to be for Roston Chase! He gets another wicket and gets the big one of Virat Kohli. A beauty to dismiss him! A fuller one, turning it on middle. Virat Kohli looks to flick this away but gets beaten as the ball turns in, and it goes on to knock the stump over. India are now 4 down!
Flatter, quicker, outside off. Virat Kohli looks to cut but misses. He is livid with himself.
Wide! Firing it down the leg side, shorter ball. Virat Kohli misses his flick and wide called.

SIX! BANG! 50 up in style and some luck! A loopy ball, fuller and on middle. Virat Kohli makes room and tonks it towards long on. Jason Holder one of the tallest men there, stretches, he gets to the ball but fails to grab it and the ball lands over the ropes for a biggie!
Quicker one, around middle. Rishabh Pant tucks it towards square leg for single.
Beaten! Shorter ball, around outside off. Virat Kohli looks to cut it away but misses.
Length, outside off. Virat Kohli pushes it towards cover-point.
Wide! Full in length, down the leg side. Virat Kohli misses his tuck and wide is given!
Shorter ball now, around middle. Rishabh Pant pulls it wide of long on for a single.
Length ball, around middle and leg. Virat Kohli clips it towards square leg and rotates the strike!
Wide! Fuller, spraying it down the leg side. Virat Kohli looks to flick but misses.
FOUR! Top shot! Short ball, angling it on middle. Virat Kohli leans back, opens the face of the bat, and guides it towards third man for a boundary.
Shorter now, around middle Virat Kohli works it away towards square leg for a brace.
Fuller, outside off. Rishabh Pant pushes it towards point. Dot to end the over!
Leg bye! Quick again, turning it in on middle. Virat Kohli misses his flick and the ball deflects off his pads goes towards third man. A leg bye taken!
Shorter and quicker, around middle and leg. Virat Kohli tucks it to the fielder at short fine leg.
SLower through the air, around off and fuller. Rishabh Pant leans and taps it towards over for a quick single.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Virat Kohli clips it towards short fine leg for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Virat Kohli gets an inside edge onto his pads. No run there!
Shorter ball, around middle. Rishabh Pant pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace.
FOUR! HAMMERED! A low full toss, around off. Rishabh Pant whips it towards the cow corner region for a boundary.
Slower and shorter outside off. Virat Kohli looks to pull but gets an inside edge on his boot. The ball goes towards point and the batters cross ends.
LEG BYE! A good-length delivery, around middle. Rishabh Pant looks to flick but misses. The ball deflects off his pads goes towards short third man. The batters steal a leg bye!
Shorter ball, around middle and off. Rishabh Pant has no room there and he just taps it towards point. Dot ball!
On a length, darting it on the pads. Virat Kohli knocks it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Pant starts with a boundary! Short ball, outside off. Pant waits and cuts it through point to get off the mark.

DRINKS! Roston Chase once again is doing a fine job and providing West Indies with important breakthroughs! India are scoring at a brisk rate, but they have lost big wickets in return as well. A good thing is Virat Kohli is still at the crease and he is looking in good form! Rishabh Pant walks out to join him.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Chase with another wicket and this time he gets the big wicket of Yadav. This is tossed up, full and on off. Yadav is early into his shot as he drives it uppishly and straight back to Chase who has to dive forward to take the low catch. It was dying but Chase did really well to get his fingers under it. It is taken upstairs just to confirm and the third umpire has no issue with it.
Is that a clean catch? The umpires check if Roston Chase has taken a clean catch. The soft signal is OUT. The replays roll in. It is indeed a clean catch and Suryakumar Yadav walks back!
Flatter and on off. Kohli dabs it to short third man for one.
Fuller ball, on off. Kohli drives it hard but straight to the fielder at covers.
Full and on middle. Yadav turns it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
West Indies fielding is very below-par till now! Fuller and outside off, Yadav drives it to covers where Kyle Mayers fails to stop it and two runs are taken. They need to put in more effort.
An arm ball, on middle, drilled down to wide of long on for a single.
A slider, on the pads. Yadav wrists it to mid-wicket for one more.
Short and on middle, punched off the back foot to point.
FOUR! Makes it looks so easy! Tossed up, full and outside off. Yadav opens the bat face and drives it through point for a boundary. Roston Chase dives inside the ring but to no avail.
On the pads, this is flicked to square leg for one more.
Short and on off. Kohli punches it to long on for a single.
Suryakumar Yadav comes to bat at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! Roston Chase gets Rohit Sharma yet again! Tosses it up, full and on middle. Sharma clears his front leg and looks to heave but gets a top edge, in the air and towards cover. Brandon King there, runs to his right and takes an easy catch. So, the drop catch hasn't proved much costly and Brandon King will be very relieved.
Commentary.Howout: c Brandon King b Roston Chase

Commentary.Commentary: A single as this is hit to deep square leg.
Short and outside off. Kohli mistimes his pull to the right of the bowler. Rohit Sharma tries to evade it but gets hit on the body.
Tossed up, on off. Sharma nudges it to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Loopy ball, full and on middle, whipped to deep square leg for a single.
Short ball, outside off, turns away as well. Sharma looks to cut but misses. Nicholas Pooran is the only one interested to appeal for it.
Short and outside off. Virat cuts it through point for one more.
An arm ball, on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, this is worked to deep point for a single.
Flatter and on off. Kohli guides it to point.
FOUR! Misfield! Short and outside off. Kohli gets on the back foot and smacks it to covers where it goes through the hands of the fielder and into the fence. Akeal Hosein is frustrated.
Akeal Hosein (2-0-14-0) comes back to bowl.

SIX! In the air and goes over for a biggie! This is on a length and outside off. Sharma looks to go over mid off but is a touch early and it takes the outer portion of the bat, in the air and over covers for a biggie. End of the Powerplay, India are 49 for 1 at the end of it.
Full ball, shaping away, outside off, pushed to mid off for a quick single.
Length and on off, this is hit to point.
FOUR! Add another boundary to the total as Kohli looks in some form here! Short in length, outside off. Kohli waits and slaps it through covers, nicely in the gap and into the fence.
FOUR! Dealing in boundaries! A full ball, outside off. Kohli lifts it nicely over mid on for a boundary.
This is full and outside off, with a fair amount of away swing. Kohli makes room and looks to slash at it but misses.
Change. Romario Shepherd to bowl now.
Good-length delivery, around off. Rohit Sharma taps it towards point. 11 runs off Jason Holder's first over!
FOUR! PUNISHED! A short ball to Rohit Sharma is always a gift! Back of a length, outside off. Rohit Sharma pulls this towards deep mid-wicket for a powerful boundary.
Tad shorter, around off. Virat Kohli gets an inside edge towards fine leg. A quick single taken!
Fuller ball, outside off, angling it in. Rohit Sharma looks to flick but gets a leading edge  towards cover for a single.
On a length ball, around middle. Virat Kohli whips it to the fielder at deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! WOW! A shorter ball, outside off. Virat Kohli makes room and slaps it over cover for a cracking boundary.
Change. Jason Holder is into the attack.
Length and on off. Sharma hops and taps it to point.

FOUR! Short again, wide of off. Rohit Sharma slices it towards backward point. Brandon King there gets a hand to it, but fails to stop the ball. The ball races away towards the third man fence for a boundary!
On a length, angling it in on off. Rohit Sharma pushes it towards mid off.
Wide! fuller, down the leg side. Rohit Sharma misses his flick and wide is called!
Yorker-length, on middle. Rohit Sharma does well to dig it out.
DROPPED! Oh, dear! A shorter ball, wide of off. Rohit Sharma stays in his crease and cuts it towards point. Brandon King there, dives to his right and fails to grab the ball. A costly drop!

Very full, around middle. Rohit Sharma looks to squeeze this out but gets an under-edge. The ball lobs up and goes towards the stump. Rohit Sharma is well aware and he guards his stumps really well. Close call!
FOUR! Top shot! A fuller ball, around middle. Virat Kohli gets low and scoops this towards fine leg for a boundary. Virat Kohli is all smiles after that shot, he knows it's a beautiful one!
Quicker again, around middle. Virat Kohli nudges it towards mid-wicket. Dot ball.
Beaten! Tad shorter, outside off. Virat Kohli looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge as the ball turns away a tad.
Quicker one and outside off. Virat Kohli leans and blocks it towards point.
FOUR! WOW! What a shot! A shorter ball, around middle and leg. Virat Kohli covers the line and tucks it towards deep square leg for a boundary.  He gets off the mark in style!
Shorter ball, around middle. Virat Kohli gets across and pushes it to mid on.
Back of a length, outside off. Rohit Sharma blocks it out. A wicket maiden to begin with for Sheldon Cottrell!
Virat Kohli is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! What an over this has been for Sheldon Cottrell! A truly deserving wicket, he strikes early and draws first blood. Another length ball, around middle. Ishan Kishan looks to flick this away, he closes the bat face too early and gets a leading edge towards cover-point. Kyle Mayers there takes an easy catch tracking back to dismiss Ishan Kishan!
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Mayers b Sheldon Cottrell

Commentary.Commentary: Review time! After a long conversation among the players. West Indies take the review. There is a huge, huge gap between the bat and the ball. UltraEdge confirms the same. Review lost!

NOT OUT! This is great bowling by Sheldon Cottrell! Another shorter ball, outside off. Ishan Kishan hangs his bat outside again as he tries to cut this away but misses. West Indies think they heard a sound and they opt for a review. The replays roll in. UltraEdge confirms no bat involved. Ishan Kishan survives! West Indies lose a review here! To be honest, a very bad review from West Indies!
Another shorter ball, around middle. Ishan Kishan pushes it back to the bowler.
Another beauty! Tad shorter, outside off, shaping away once again. Ishan Kishan looks to push it again, but misses.
Sheldon Cottrell starts with a back-of-a-length ball, shaping away from outside off. Ishan Kishan staays in his crease and looks to push this away but misses!
Sheldon Cottrell to bowl from the other end.
Fuller now, around middle. Rohit Sharma pushes it back to the bowler. 10 runs off the first over!
Shorter ball, outside off. Ishan Kishan gets down on his knee and swipes it towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Another low full toss, around middle. Rohit Sharma gets low and sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Another free-hit gone for a single. Could have been worse for West Indies!
No ball! A full toss, around middle. Ishan Kishan sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. Akeal Hosein oversteps once again, and a no ball called. Free-hit coming up!

No ball! A quicker one again, down the leg side. Ishan Kishan makes room and looks to flick but misses. The keeper fails to collect the ball as well. The ball races away towards the boundary. A wide was given but the umpire changed his decision after consulting upstairs. Akeal Hosein has overstepped here and a no ball is given! Free-hit to follow!
Quicker now, shorter, around middle. Ishan Kishan gets an outside edge towards point. No run there!
Tosses it up, full again, outside off. Ishan Kishan leans and drives it to the fielder at mid off.

Akeal Hosein begins with a loopy ball, outside off and full in length. Rohit Sharma looks to drive but gets an inside edge towards deep square leg for a single. India and Rohit Sharma are up and running!

All in readiness. The players walk out to the middle. Ishan Kishan and Rohit Sharma are the openers for India. Ian Bishop rings the iconic bell at Eden Gardens. Spin to start with as Akeal Hosein has the ball. But before that, the players take the knee in support of the Black Lives Matter movement. Now, we are ready and let's play says the umpire.

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India says they need to get back to their basics, they need to understand the situation and take the game forward, they just want to come out and bat freely. Mentions that as a team they want to improve in all the departments, and that is their focus. There is always room for improvement and he says they want to get better every game. Concludes by saying that they are playing with the same team.

Kieron Pollard, the skipper of West Indies, says that it looks a good track to bat on and the last game dew was the factor. They want to avoid that. Mentions that they will try to bowl first and limit them to a low total. States that they will try and continue to execute their skills. Informs that they have made one change in their team. Jason Holder is fit and he is in for Fabian Allen.

India (Unchanged Playing XI) - Rohit Sharma (C), Ishan Kishan, Virat Kohli, Rishabh Pant (WK), Suryakumar Yadav, Venkatesh Iyer, Harshal Patel, Deepak Chahar, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Yuzvendra Chahal, Ravi Bishnoi

West Indies (Playing XI) - Brandon King, Kyle Mayers, Nicholas Pooran (WK), Roston Chase, Rovman Powell, Kieron Pollard (C), Jason Holder (In for Fabian Allen), Akeal Hosein, Odean Smith, Romario Shepherd, Sheldon Cottrell.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favor of Kieron Pollard. West Indies have elected BOWL first.

West Indies have a powerful batting line-up, but they have not been able to display their magic yet. Coming into this game, they will want the middle-order, in particular, to step up. West Indies could make a few changes. We did see Akeal Hosein being promoted up the order which did not work in their favor. However, they could shuffle things once more. They could get in Jason Holder, who has been in some fine touch with the ball and bat. He could prove to be a threat. They do have the quality in their ranks and are well and truly capable of leveling this series here. Also, Kieron Pollard is all set to play his 100th T20I game, so he would love to reflex with a win. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

India have been dominating in this entire series so far. We have seen the top-order firing, Rohit Sharma in particular, and the middle-order chipping in with vital runs. However, Virat Kohli has not been at his best and he will want to get some runs under his belt and give a solid start to India in case of an early wicket. Ravi Bishnoi in his first game was one of the main architects behind India's victory in the first T20I, he will want to continue in the same way. Rohit Sharma and his men look unstoppable and they will want to carry on the same way and seal the series.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second T20I between the two power-packed sides, India and West Indies. India clinched the first game convincingly and have taken a 1-0 lead in this series. West Indies are still in search of their first victory in this tour. But this is the format that is best suited for the Men in Maroon, and we can never write them off. They will look to level the series in this match.
... MATCH DAY ...
